description_en: Queries the resources in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内的资源列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-discovered-resources --resource-id eni-hp31cqoba96jagtz0000 --resource-name launch-advisor-20200330 --resource-deleted 1 --max-results 10 --next-token IWBjqMYSy0is7zSMGu160000 --resource-types ACS::ECS::NetworkInterface --regions cn-huhehaote --aggregator-id ca-c560626622af00050000 --resource-account-id 1009318965420000 --start-update-timestamp 1722441600000 --end-update-timestamp 1724947200000 --exclude-resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance,ACS::ECS::NetworkInterface --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateDiscoveredResources

parameters.help_en:
The status of the resource. Valid values:

0: The resource is deleted. A resource is displayed as Deleted in Cloud Config after it is deleted from the source Alibaba Cloud service.

1 (Default): The resource is active. A resource is displayed as Active in Cloud Config if it is properly managed
parameters.help_zh:
资源状态。取值：

0：已删除。如果您已在目标云产品中删除某个资源，则在配置审计的资源列表中显示该资源为已删除。
1（默认值）：保有中。如果您的资源被正常管理，则在配置审计的资源列表中显示该资源为保有中
parameters.name: resource_deleted

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: If the response is truncated, use the `NextToken` to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource resides. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属的地域ID。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resources to be queried belong. The account is a member of the account group
parameters.help_zh: 账号组内待查询资源所属的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: resource_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. This is a standard UTC timestamp. The following limits apply:

The value must be a timestamp in milliseconds.

The value cannot be later than EndUpdateTimestamp. The interval between StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp cannot exceed 30 days.

You must specify both StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp, or leave both empty
parameters.help_zh:
资源时间范围查询的开始时间，采用标准UTC时间戳。取值限制：
必须是毫秒时间戳。
不能大于EndUpdateTimestamp，且与EndUpdateTimestamp间隔范围小于等于30天。
StartUpdateTimestamp与EndUpdateTimestamp必须同时填写或同时不填写
parameters.name: start_update_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This is a standard UTC timestamp. The following limits apply:

The value must be a timestamp in milliseconds.

The value cannot be earlier than StartUpdateTimestamp. The interval between StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp cannot exceed 30 days.

You must specify both StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp, or leave both empty
parameters.help_zh:
资源时间范围查询的截止时间，采用标准UTC时间戳。取值限制：
必须是毫秒时间戳。
不能小于StartUpdateTimestamp，且与StartUpdateTimestamp间隔范围小于等于30天。
StartUpdateTimestamp与EndUpdateTimestamp必须同时填写或同时不填写
parameters.name: end_update_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The resource types to exclude. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,). This parameter has a higher priority than the ResourceTypes parameter
parameters.help_zh: 排除的资源类型，多资源类型用逗号分隔，与ResourceTypes字段冲突时，该字段具有更高优先级
parameters.name: exclude_resource_types
